name: Koffi Shoppi
address: 196 Majuba Ave, Hartenbos, Mossel Bay, 6520, South Africa
description_short: Hartenbos coffee shop serving quality brews, light meals, and sweet treats in a relaxed neighbourhood setting.
description_long:
Koffi Shoppi brings a welcome dose of caffeine culture to Hartenbos, just off Majuba Avenue. This friendly neighbourhood coffee shop has become a local favourite for its consistently good coffee, freshly baked goods, and laid-back atmosphere that invites you to linger a little longer.

The menu covers all the essentials — proper espresso-based drinks, light breakfast options, sandwiches, and a tempting display of cakes and pastries. It's the kind of place where you can grab a quick takeaway on your way to the beach or settle in with a cappuccino and a good book. The relaxed vibe and welcoming staff make it feel more like visiting a friend's kitchen than just another coffee stop.

Conveniently located in the heart of Hartenbos, Koffi Shoppi serves the local community and holidaymakers alike. Whether you're after your morning fix, a mid-afternoon pick-me-up, or something sweet to round off a beach day, this unpretentious spot delivers without fuss.
